title: Outcome record
description: Toxicity outcomes of one patient after therapy start. One record per patient, linked to the baseline record by patient_id. Days count from therapy start (day 1).

patient_id.description: Identifier of the patient, as in the baseline record.

severe_toxicity_90d.description: At least one adverse event of CTCAE grade 3 to 5 within 90 days of therapy start.

severe_toxicity_day.description: Day of the first adverse event of grade 3 to 5. Null if there was none within 90 days.

ild.description: Drug-related interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis of any grade within 730 days of therapy start.

ild_onset_day.description: Day of onset of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis. Null if there was none.

ild_grade.description: Highest CTCAE grade of the interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis. Null if there was none.
